item.title: Rust Smart Contracts #6: Storage Patterns in ink! You Can Actually Maintain
item.description: Stop dumping everything into one big storage struct. Learn the core storage patterns in ink!—single values, mappings, many-to-many relations, and lazy configs—so your contracts stay readable, cheap to run, and easy to extend.
